expanded_name: Support-Preserving Adaptive Residual Kernel with In-domain Neighbour Gating
research_question: Does target-independent inverse-frequency weighting improve a randomized tree ensemble under fresh leave-one-element-out band-gap shifts, while retaining the v2 Extra Trees advantage over GPU CatBoost?
hypothesis: Stoichiometric inverse-frequency weighting computed only from each outer training set will reduce domination by common elemental environments and improve unseen-element macro MAE relative to an otherwise identical unweighted Extra Trees ensemble.
falsifier: V3 is not supported unless a nonzero frequency exponent improves macro MAE over the aggregation-matched unweighted Extra Trees control by more than 0.01 eV, improves at least five of eight fresh development elements, improves over CatBoost by more than 0.02 eV, and yields complete finite manifest-valid evidence.
intended_contribution: A target-independent composition-frequency weighting rule for randomized tree ensembles, evaluated with compute-matched controls on a fresh element-exclusion panel.

included: preserved v2 development element holdouts Cu, Ag, B
fresh v3 development element holdouts O, S, In, Ge, Sb, Ba, Co, F
confirmatory element holdouts Li, Zn, Ga, Se, Te

Disposition: DEVELOPMENT_NOT_SUPPORTED. Protected Li/Zn/Ga/Se/Te outcomes and official folds remained unopened; no confirmatory run was launched.

hosted_development.authorized_scope: Development only: all eight frozen gate settings and four baselines across Cu/Ag/B

disposition_scope: The frozen v3 development admission rule failed. The exact hosted run and independent verification are retained; protected Li/Zn/Ga/Se/Te confirmation and official-fold evaluation remain unopened and unauthorized.

development_findings.interpretation: Negligible development benefit from support gating; no confirmatory inference. All eight settings are within the preregistered 0.002 eV selection tolerance.
development_findings.caveat: Resolved by diagnostic v1: direct absolute-error HGB predicts zero for every training/test row, due to zero-median nonnegative targets and uniform initial gradients. Squared-error direct baseline substantially improves development error; original v1 is preserved.

confirmation_readiness.reason: The frozen v3 selected model improved macro MAE by 0.009123345453943471 eV over its aggregation-matched unweighted Extra Trees control; admission required a strict improvement greater than 0.01 eV.

development_v2_findings.interpretation: Pseudo-exclusion harm ranking transferred weakly and did not produce a practically meaningful outer-element MAE improvement.

development_v3_findings.interpretation: Frequency balancing produced a small development improvement and passed the element-count and CatBoost gates, but missed the preregistered strict improvement threshold against the matched unweighted forest. The conjunctive development gate therefore failed.
